projectName: RCCG Place of Victory - Client App

rules.description: Use functional components with React hooks. Follow clean component structure — logic at top, JSX at bottom. Use Tailwind for styling and maintain semantic HTML.
Always use Firestore modular SDK. Ensure public reads use security rules defined in firestore.rules. No sensitive keys in client code.
Follow consistent spacing: sections should have at least `py-20 sm:py-24`. Apply responsive typography (text-3xl md:text-5xl). Use animation utilities only from Tailwind or Framer Motion.
Each page should be accessible, SEO-optimized, and mobile responsive. Import shared layout and metadata dynamically.
Use Tailwind CSS only. Avoid inline styles unless dynamic. Maintain consistent color palette (#0A1A44 primary, #F3F4F6 background, #FFFFFF text contrast).
Ensure full-width responsive image (w-full h-auto), maintain 16:9 aspect ratio, and no cropped content. Title should be above image in centered alignment.
Background image should be parallax-style with dark overlay. Text must remain legible with proper contrast ratio (WCAG AA minimum).
Avoid hardcoding data. Always fetch from Firestore using safe queries. Use SWR or React Query for caching when necessary.
